scope: Declared benchmark assumptions; no physical insertion or wire test data are available.

housing.mating_surface: All original source triangles, including cavities; partitioned seal/latch vertex motion
housing.support_proxy: Eleven source cross-section convex hulls, only for fingers/supports/cables; never a cavity-filling mating hull

seal.model: Eight massive independent radial/axial folding slides

latch.model: Massive passive spring hinge carrying source latch vertices

mass_accounting: Seal/latch masses and inertias are partitioned from the assumed source solid; finger accessory mass is added to original pad inertia.

cable.termination: Permanent endpoint plus a second material point 15 mm along the lead-out axis. These two connect constraints model the designed crimp/grommet bending attachment, leave axial twisting free, and never attach a gripper or socket.
cable.junction: A free 3-g massive equivalent splice envelope of 16-mm diameter inside an authored physical retaining cage. Two keeper rails form a 7-mm cable slot. No world attachment constraint is used. The splice geometry and mass are authored nominal assumptions.
cable.nominal_loading_shape: Smooth loading arches with 20-mm straight terminal lead-outs. Segment cut lengths and nominal masses are in work_order.json. The bent initial shape is a joint configuration, not the straight spring rest shape. Manufacturing and constitutive parameters are nominal assumptions.
cable.spring_discretization: Interior ball stiffness EI / mean adjacent segment length. Junction-root ball has zero spring stiffness. Straight identity quaternions define qpos_spring; bent loading state is a separate initial keyframe.

needed_for_transfer: Measured gripper gap/force and pad behavior
Revision-matched insertion, release and retention curves
Wire/bundle bending, torsion, friction and termination tests
Fixture and sensor calibration and pilot assembly trials

robot_servo.gravity_compensation: Nominal arm links and gripper base, not measured vendor firmware

monitoring.lift_evidence: At least 100 ms of bilateral pad contact above 10 mm of lift
monitoring.inspection: Geometry, support, route and force checks at the stated physical sampling period

splice_fixture.description: Close-fitting authored cage with a nominal 0.15-mm side/floor/keeper clearance; the free massive splice is located through physical contact only.
